summary: This note describes the television show Gavin & Stacey, produced by Baby Cow Productions for BBC Wales. It ran for 20 episodes across three series and two Christmas specials, broadcast from 13 May 2007 to 1 January 2010. The show moved from BBC Three to BBC Two and then BBC One as its audience grew, and its final episodes aired in prime time on Christmas Day 2009 and New Year's Day 2010.
one_line: Gavin & Stacey was a BBC Wales-produced television show broadcast from 2007 to 2010, moving from BBC Three to BBC One as its audience grew.
key_facts: Gavin & Stacey was produced by Baby Cow Productions for BBC Wales.
The show ran for a total of 20 episodes.
The episodes were broadcast from 13 May 2007 to 1 January 2010.
The show comprised three series and two Christmas specials.
The series was initially shown on BBC Three.
A growing following meant the series was subsequently moved to BBC Two, and finally to BBC One.
The last episodes of the final series formed a significant part of the prime time BBC seasonal programming.
The final episodes were broadcast on Christmas Day 2009 and New Year's Day 2010.
